summary: PASS — backend + frontend for the LIVE conversation on the Team page. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases green (BOS grounded conversation, WHL REG grounded with NO player suggestions, missing text/audio -> 400, unknown team -> 404, follow flow BOS 'Keep an eye on Pastrnak' -> conversation_id captured -> 'Yes do it' turn -> action.type=='follow' with entity.player_id set). Every BOS suggestion entity id was validated against the real /api/nhl/team/BOS whitelist (players/team/game). Frontend @ /team/BOS (NHL) and /team/REG?league=whl: both routes are NOT behind onboarding — direct-navigate rendered the passive TickerDesk (testID 'ticker-desk' + 'desk-play') AND the LiveDesk (testID 'live-desk' + 'live-mic' + 'live-type-toggle') as one connected block, NO autoplay (playCalls=0 on entry), NO mic prompt on entry (getUserMedia=0, permQuery=0). TEXT fallback: typed 'Who should I watch this year?' -> compact thread rendered YOU + REGGIE + MARC lines, 3 grounded chips (Pastrnak / Geekie / Swayman 'open profile'), host audio played after deliberate send (playCalls=2 for the two beats). Chip navigation: tapping the Pastrnak chip routed the app to /player/8477956. Follow chip: 'Can you keep an eye on Pastrnak?' surfaced a 'Keep an eye on David Pastrnak' follow_player chip; tapping it flipped the chip to 'Following David Pastrnak' with checkmark icon and a green 'Following David Pastrnak' toast. WHL REG grounded reply produced only follow_team + game chips ('Follow the Pats', 'Next game vs PA') — no player suggestions, exactly as required for a league with no roster. Mic path: pre-tap probe getUserMedia=0; the moment I tap 'live-mic' getUserMedia goes to 1 — deliberate only. LiveDesk is imported ONLY by /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx (grep confirmed) so Home/Recap/Next/Stats are architecturally untouched. One-audio-session preserved through the send path (endSession() runs synchronously before the network fetch and any new play) — passive desk audio was paused (pauseCalls=1) as soon as the live send began. Note: the composite probe recorded maxConcurrent=2 for one brief instant during the transition passive->live (see 'observations' below); pauseCalls confirms the passive was killed, so audibly the invariant is met, but the probe still saw two overlapping .play() calls — flagging for main agent.
action_items: OPTIONAL / low-priority: investigate the brief maxConcurrent=2 observed by an HTMLMediaElement.play() probe during the transition from the passive TickerDesk desk-play to the LiveDesk send()->playBeats path. The passive desk WAS paused (pauseCalls=1 recorded from endSession) so the invariant holds audibly, but a second .play() invocation overlapped for the tick before the pause event decremented the concurrent counter. Likely fix: in LiveDesk.send(), await a microtask (or call stopAudio() explicitly, not just endSession()) before returning control so the passive TickerDesk's in-flight beat can't call .play() on its already-fetched TTS audio for one more frame. Not a shipping blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: ticker_converse.py grounding is airtight: converse_turn() rebuilds suggestions ONLY from by_ref = {links[i].ref}, so an LLM-fabricated ref is silently dropped. Every emitted suggestion is guaranteed to resolve to a real player_id / team abbr / game id.

server.py POST /api/ticker/converse correctly (a) requires text OR audio (400 on both empty verified), (b) 404s an unknown subject via prov.team_page, (c) persists conversation history bounded to last 20 turns keyed by conversation_id, and (d) remembers the last follow_* suggestion so an affirmation ('yes', 'do it', 'keep an eye') on the next turn resolves to action.type=='follow' with the whitelisted entity — verified end-to-end.

LiveDesk.tsx: onMic only calls rec.start() after Haptics + endSession() — no getUserMedia on mount. Verified empirically (getUserMedia stayed at 0 across full team-page load + text-only conversation + chip nav). rec.stop() -> send(clip) path is unreachable in headless but the text-fallback branch fully exercises the same send() pipeline.
recorder.web.ts correctly uses navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia directly (bypasses expo-audio's on-load permission ping that regressed Safari). Confirmed no permQuery on entry.
api.converse posts a real FormData with either blob (web) or {uri,name,type} (native) — matches FastAPI's Form/File(UploadFile) signature.
LiveDesk is imported ONLY by /app/frontend/app/team/[id].tsx (grep confirmed) — Home/Recap/Next/Stats and the passive TickerDesk are architecturally unchanged.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required flows on /team/BOS + /team/REG?league=whl (no-autoplay, no-mic-on-entry, text-fallback thread, 3 grounded chips, player-chip nav to /player/8477956, follow-chip flip to 'Following David Pastrnak', WHL no-player-suggestions rule)

seed_data_creation: None — the deep team routes bypass onboarding so no seeded state required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For POST /api/ticker/converse tests use multipart FormData (requests.post(..., data={...}) is sufficient for text-only). Claude round-trips take ~10-20s per turn; keep TIMEOUT>=60s. The follow flow requires two sequential calls sharing conversation_id — the second turn must contain an AFFIRM regex hit ('yes', 'yeah', 'do it', 'keep an eye', ...). WHL grounding rule: because prov.team_page for WHL returns no roster/scorers/goalie, the whitelist has no P:/FP: entries so suggestions can only be team/game/follow_team. Frontend probe pattern for one-audio-session: init-script wrap HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play/pause into window.__probe {playCalls,pauseCalls,currentConcurrent,maxConcurrent}, and wrap navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia + navigator.permissions.query. Deep routes /team/BOS and /team/REG?league=whl bypass onboarding — no seeded follows needed. Text fallback path: testID 'live-type-toggle' -> 'live-text-input' -> 'live-text-send'. Chips are 'live-suggestion-{n}'.
